rule: For one stated code requirement, check each rule below and emit one candidate per implied requirement the code does not already satisfy. Investigate the code first and prune already-satisfied candidates before generating anything.

categories.name: error-path
categories.rule: Every failure of the requirement has an observed error path with a failing-then-passing test.
categories.probe: Read the cited test file for a failing run before proposing a new error-path item.

categories.name: input-validation
categories.rule: Every input of the requirement is validated and the allowed values are stated.
categories.probe: Read the validators for an existing rule before proposing a new validation item.

categories.name: auth-check
categories.rule: Every state-changing operation checks who may run it.
categories.probe: Grep for the existing permission check before proposing a new auth item.

categories.name: persist-shape
categories.rule: Every persisted field has a named key, type and default.
categories.probe: Grep the store for an existing key before proposing a new persist item.

categories.name: exit-code
categories.rule: Every command reports success or failure through its exit code.
categories.probe: Read the command entry point for exit codes before proposing a new exit-code item.

categories.name: log-line
categories.rule: Every state change leaves one log line the gate can read.
categories.probe: Grep for the existing log line before proposing a new logging item.

categories.name: help-text
categories.rule: Every user-facing command documents its flags in help text.
categories.probe: Read the help output for existing flag docs before proposing a new help item.

categories.name: rollback-note
categories.rule: Every migration states how it rolls back.
categories.probe: Read the migration notes for a rollback plan before proposing a new rollback item.
